title: North Point Mall Mixed-Use / Arena District Redevelopment
size: Nearly 100-acre phased redevelopment; approved plan includes a 20,000-seat arena, 1,385 apartments, 750,000 SF office, 650 hotel rooms, about 565,000 SF commercial space, cinema, 2,000-seat ice rink, conference center, parks/open space and seven parking decks
timing: Newly added September 22 after repository duplicate check. Alpharetta approved the redevelopment in August. Reporting indicates meaningful demolition/building construction may still be a year or more away, but the approval allows site preparation, utility work and preliminary construction to begin. Treat as an early relationship/qualification lead with Jamestown and future civil/demolition teams, not as an open subcontract bid. Arena-dependent elements remain contingent on an NHL franchise.

title: Post Road South Widening — SR 9 to Kelly Mill Road
size: Major widening/reconstruction to two lanes each direction with 16-foot median, multi-use path, sidewalks, drainage, water lines, signals, markings and landscaping; 1,825-day contract
timing: Reverified September 22: ITB 26-80-1514 remains due September 24 at 2:00 PM ET. Only two days remain. Scope includes roadway widening, drainage, water, asphalt, signals, sidewalks/multi-use path, markings and landscaping; 10% DBE goal. Specialty firms should contact bidding GDOT-qualified primes immediately before final bid leveling.
source: Forsyth County Board of Commissioners / Georgia Procurement Registry
